title: fix(auth): compare tokens in constant time
body:
## Rationale
Ordinary equality may reveal the first differing position through timing; token validation should avoid that comparison leak.

## Testing
Validation has not been performed; test selection is pending.

## Limitations
Unrelated features remain outside scope; risk assessment is pending.

## Breaking changes
None for supported ASCII tokens; unsupported token types are outside the contract.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/auth.py b/src/auth.py
--- a/src/auth.py
+++ b/src/auth.py
@@ -1,2 +1,5 @@
+import hmac
+
+
 def valid_token(actual, expected):
-    return actual == expected
+    return hmac.compare_digest(actual, expected)

diff --git a/tests/test_auth.py b/tests/test_auth.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_auth.py
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+from src.auth import valid_token
+
+
+def test_tokens():
+    assert valid_token('abc', 'abc')
+    assert not valid_token('abc', 'abd')
